A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ags presented on MHC class II molecules by B cells induce the generation of CD4+ regulatory cells, while Ags presented on the MHC class I molecule induce CD8+ regulatory cells.

the eye can be used to induce peripheral tolerance.
